description:
(Summary from jobright.ai; the original posting may say more.)

Lockheed Martin is hiring an early-career Software Engineer to develop, test, document, and maintain software for business and mission problems. The role applies software development standards and processes throughout the lifecycle and resolves software and system issues.
Early-Career Software Engineer designing, testing, and debugging business and mission software through the development life cycle

Responsibilities:
• Plans, conducts, and coordinates software development activities
• Designs, develops, documents, tests, and debugs software that contains logical and mathematical solutions to business/mission problems or questions in computer language for solutions by means of data processing equipment
• Applies the appropriate standards, processes, procedures, and tools throughout the development life cycle
• Applies knowledge of computer hardware and software, subject matter to be programmed in business/mission applications, information processing techniques used, and information gathered from system users to develop software
• Corrects program errors, prepares operating instructions, compiles documentation of program development, and analyzes system capabilities to resolve questions of program intent, output requirements, input data acquisition, programming techniques, and controls
• Ensures software standards are met

Requirements:
• Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Software Engineering or equivalent technical discipline with a concentration in computer science courses
• Experience with Object Oriented C++ Software Development
• Experience with Automated Test tools and Techniques and Static Code Analysis
• Hands on experience with the Linux Environment
• Familiarity with Agile Development and configuration Management tools (Git, JIRA, Confluence)
• Must be a US Citizen
• This position will require a government security clearance
• This position is located at a facility that requires special access

Preferred:
• Experience with Software Modeling (UML) and architecture
• Understanding and application of Design Patterns
• Experience in common scripting languages (ex: bash, Python)
• Experience with Code Optimization
• Experience with Continuous Integration/ Continuous Delivery (CI/CD) Methodologies
• Experience working in a team environment
• Digital Signal Processing
• CUDA development
• Embedded Applications
